final: WITH invoice_averages AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(product_quantity) AS average_quantity, SUM(derived_product_cost) AS total_product_cost, SUM(derived_total_cost) AS total_cost FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_quantity) AS overall_average FROM invoice_averages) SELECT i.invoice_number, i.average_quantity, (i.total_product_cost - i.total_cost) / NULLIF(i.total_cost, 0) AS cost_ratio, i.average_quantity - o.overall_average AS difference_above_average FROM invoice_averages AS i CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE i.average_quantity > o.overall_average ORDER BY (difference_above_average IS NULL), difference_above_average DESC LIMIT 10
